subject: Kickoff & Activation Velocity Plan — Helix Pharmaceuticals
messages:
From: Sam Tanner <sam.tanner@helixpharma.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 08 Nov 2025 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Implementation velocity and milestones

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Helix is excited to move forward. We want to align on a tight go-live window (targeting 2026-01-25) and get a clear mutual action plan so our internal PMs can budget the integration sprints.

High level requests from my side:
- Clearly defined milestones and owners for data ingestion, model mapping, and canary testing.
- A 6-week sprint cadence with checkpoints every Tuesday.
- Security/compliance artifacts we need before provisioning (SOC 2 summary, retention defaults).

Can we schedule a short kickoff on Monday to finalize owners and agree the first two milestones? Elena (cc'd on follow-up) will be our integration lead.

Thanks,
Sam Tanner
Head of Platform Integrations
Helix Pharmaceuticals

——

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Elena Morales <elena@helixpharma.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Implementation velocity and milestones

Sam — thanks, really appreciate the quick timeline. We're aligned on a 2026-01-25 target and have sketched an accelerated activation plan. I've attached the first-draft MAP (Helix_MAP_v1.0.xlsx) and the platform security one-pager for your compliance team.

Key milestones (proposed):
- Week 0 (Nov 17) — Kickoff & environment access requests (Owner: Marissa, Deliverable: Access matrix)
- Week 1–2 (Nov 24–Dec 5) — Data ingestion & schema mapping (Owner: Helix/Elena, Support: Ben)
- Week 3 (Dec 8) — First pass model validation & prompt alignment (Owner: Priyom)
- Week 4–5 (Dec 15–Dec 26) — Canary testing in staging; latency/cost tuning (Owner: Ben)
- Week 6 (Jan 5–Jan 16) — Acceptance testing & runbook finalization (Owners: Marissa + Helix PM)
- Cutover window (Jan 18–25) — Go-live and 72hr bridge support (Owners: Redwood Ops + Helix Dev)

Immediate asks for Monday's kickoff (30–45 min):
1) Helix to confirm primary build resource (Elena?) and a secondary contact.
2) Helix to share a sample data extract and schema before Thursday.
3) Redwood to provide IP/retention defaults and required support SLAs.

I've called out owners in the MAP and left a column for due dates. If that timeline is too aggressive, we can shift the cutover by a week.

Attachments: Helix_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-platform-security-summary.pdf (doc)

Thanks — Marissa

Thanks Marissa — the MAP looks good overall. Two small updates from my side:
1) Add a pre-canary performance smoke test (internal) the week before canary — owner: Redwood Performance (I'll take point).
2) Recommend we schedule a dedicated 'security review' call with Helix's compliance folks the week of Nov 24 so the SOC 2/retention items are locked early.

Also adding a brief ops checklist to the MAP: provisioning steps, KMS integration notes, and a rollback plan with clear owners. I'll drop a stub in the shared Box folder by EOD.

On the kickoff: 11/17 10:00 AM PST works for me. Sam / Elena — does that work on your end?

- We'll need a short list of acceptance criteria for model outputs (3–4 examples per workflow) before Dec 1. I added an "Acceptance Criteria" tab in the MAP for Helix to populate.

I'll be on the kickoff 11/17 and will bring the initial validation checklist.
